name: homelab-learning
description: A pitiful attempt to learn and remember

scripts.anki:link: find . -type f -iname "*.md" -not -path "*/my-anki-cards/*" -exec sh -c 'grep -q "^[QA]:" "$1" && rel=$(echo "$1" | sed "s|^\./||") && name=$(echo "$rel" | sed "s|/|__|g") && ln -sf "$(pwd)/$rel" "./my-anki-cards/$name"' _ {} \;
